data.name: Quaid
data.gender_notes: Quaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is in charge, the ruler, the owner, the chief. A title of respect and honor, indicating strength, wisdom, and leadership abilities. The name Quaid carries the meaning “Leader, Chief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Quaid usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, chief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to someone who is meant to be a leader in spiritual matters, guiding others towards the right path.
data.etymology: Quaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, Chief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quaid total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: قائد
in_arabic.long_meaning: القائد هو زعيم أو قائد مجموعة، ويتضمن هذا الاسم概念 القيادة والزعامة، وهو مصطلح مشتق من الجذر العربي ق و د، والذي يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف القائد أو الزعيم، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: قائد
in_urdu.long_meaning: قائد گروہ کا سربراہ یا رہنما ہوتا ہے، اور اس نام میں قیادت اور رہنمائی کا تصور شامل ہے، یہ نام عربی gốc ق و د سے مشتق ہے، جو قرآن پاک میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا بڑا महत्व ہے

in_hindi.name: क़ाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ाद समूह का नेता या मार्गदर्शक होता है, और इस नाम में नेतृत्व और मार्गदर्शन की अवधारणा शामिल है, यह नाम अरबी मूल ق و د से व्युत्पन्न है, जो कुरान में भी उपयोग किया गया है, और इस्लामी संस्कृति में इसका बड़ा महत्व है

in_pashto.name: قائد
in_pashto.long_meaning: قائد ډله مشر یا رهبر دی، او دا نوم د قیادت او رهبرۍ مفهوم شامل دی، دا نوم د عربي ریښې ق و د څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د قرآن کریم کې هم کارول شوی دی، او د افغان/پښتنو دود İz میں دا نوم ډېر महत्वपورنه دی

in_english.name: Quaid
in_english.meaning: leader or guide of a group
in_english.long_meaning: Quaid means leader or guide of a group, and this name encompasses the concept of leadership and guidance, derived from the Arabic root ق و د, used in the Quran to describe a leader or guide, and holds significant importance in Islamic culture and tradition

pronunciation.urdu: قائد کی تلفظ کی تفصیل: ق کے ساتھ زبر اور اید کے ساتھ زیر
pronunciation.hindi: क़ाद का उच्चारण विवरण: क के साथ मात्रा और आ के साथ अनुस्वार
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د قائد د تلفظ تفصیل: ق کے ساتھ زبر اور اید کے ساتھ زیر

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Khan" is also derived from the Persian word for "king", reminding us that every believer is the king of their own conscience and actions, upholding integrity, justice, and righteous behavior. ( Symbolic Metaphor )

historical_references.reference: Quaid-i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah was the founding father of Pakistan and served as its first Governor-General from 1947 until his death in 1948.

Quaid-e-Millat Ibn Taymiyyah (1263-1328 AD) was a prominent scholar and reformer in the Islamic world during the late Middle Ages, known for his influential works on Islamic jurisprudence, theology, and politics.
